releases.description:
This release contains the following features:

* **Friend pages** — name, birthday, relationship, nickname, location
* **Ideas** — five categories (gift, restaurant, activity, conversation, misc), grouped display, resurfacing dates
* **Events/Timeline** — flexible-precision dates, met-origin, check off an idea to log it as an event
* **Birthdays** — belated window, daily startup digest, star sign/zodiac/birthstone trivia (optional)
* **Diary** — dated entries, edits natively, links into friends' timelines
* **Groups** — multi-group tagging, group-level ideas, member management
* **Dashboard** — upcoming birthdays, upcoming events/reminders, search, quick actions
* **Drafts** — zero-friction capture, triage later into an idea or field
* **Plans** — trip/hangout containers with ideas, travel, accommodation, packing list, cost splitting
* **Reminders** — standalone dated reminders shown on the dashboard
* **Somedays** — a wishlist of ideas that can graduate into a Plan
* **Quick capture** — global command to jot a thought against a friend from anywhere
releases.name: 1.0.1 • Initial release
